test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

In my view, this falls within the exception permitting warranties seizure in ______ circumstances.
solution: The correct answer is **"exigent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Exigent"** means urgent or pressing. (अत्यावश्यक या दबाव डालने वाला) • **Example:** *She told me that it's an **exigent**__ problem.* • The sentence is talking about an exception that allows warranties to be seized in certain urgent circumstances so it fits the context of the sentence. • So, the correct answer is **Option 4**. **Correct sentence:** *In my view, this falls within the exception permitting warranties seizure in __**exigent**__ circumstances.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Reverent** means showing deep respect or admiration, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (श्रद्घालु) • **Sparse** means thinly dispersed or scattered, which also does not fit the context of the sentence. (राशि या मात्रा की दृष्टि से थोड़ा, छितरा हुआ (न कि घना); झिल्‍लड़, विरल) • **Recondite** means difficult to understand or obscure, which does not fit the context of the sentence. ((तथ्य, विषय आदि) छुपा हुआ, गूढ़, गहन, कठिन; दुर्बोध) 3a:Tc41, The correct answer is **"cynical."**
